name: agent-index-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-index on a fresh box and assert its standalone install/behave contract. agent-index is a local retrieval service with a CLI, HTTP service shell, direct `agent-index mcp` toolset, and read-only `agent-mcp` bridge; this scenario validates the solo install payload, self-provisioning service runtime, login-shell binstub with a real version, and idempotent read/status/health surfaces without requiring a durable embedding engine or model build. Distinct from agent-index-cutover, which validates graceful version cutover. Name-free / public.
validates: agent-index standalone solo install + read behavior

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
standalone read/status/health verbs degrade cleanly with no built index
